name: Arabic Knowledge Base Composite Textpack
description: Generated source-backed Arabic KB recipe composite for Arabic WordNet lexical-semantic resources and Wikidata entity artifacts.

publishabilityEvidence.productionGradeSourceCoverage: Generated recipe composite over Arabic WordNet and artifact-backed Wikidata components. Arabic WordNet provides lexical-semantic KB resources; Wikidata provides a explicit artifact descriptor for entity labels, aliases, relations, and ontology data.
publishabilityEvidence.auditedLicense: The exact Arabic WordNet v4.1.0 and Wikidata main structured source rows are approved; required component packages carry package-local license evidence for Arabic WordNet CC-BY-4.0 and Wikidata CC0 structured data.
publishabilityEvidence.declaredScope: Arabic KB component composite backed by Arabic WordNet lexical semantics and a Wikidata main entity artifact descriptor. It does not claim local Wikidata entity lookup until a materialized entity extract is generated, morphology, syntax, search, corpus, parallel, dialectal Arabic, Classical/Quranic Arabic, or full language-composite coverage.
